{"content": "1|# Research Plan: Georgia O'Keeffe New Mexico Landscape Oil Paintings (pre-1940) at the Art Institute of Chicago (as of June 2024)
2|
3|## Objective
4|Identify all Georgia O'Keeffe works in the Art Institute of Chicago (AIC) collection as of June 2024 that meet ALL criteria:
5|- Subject: New Mexico landscapes
6|- Date: Created before 1940
7|- Medium: Oil on canvas/board
8|
9|---
10|
11|## Phase 1: Primary Source — AIC Collection Database
12|
13|### 1.1 AIC Online Collection Search
14|- **URL**: https://www.artic.edu/collection
15|- **Search Strategy**:
16|  - Artist: "Georgia O'Keeffe"
17|  - Filter by classification: "Paintings"
18|  - Filter by date: before 1940 (use date range or manual review)
19|  - Keyword searches: "New Mexico", "Taos", "Santa Fe", "Abiquiu", "Ghost Ranch", "Pedernal", "Chama River", "Black Place", "White Place"
20|
21|### 1.2 AIC Collections API (if available)
22|- Check for public API at https://api.artic.edu/docs/
23|- Query endpoint: `/artworks` with filters:
24|  - `artist_title=Georgia O'Keeffe`
25|  - `classification_title=Paintings`
26|  - `date_start=0&date_end=1939`
27|  - Search `subject_titles` for New Mexico-related terms
28|
29|### 1.3 AIC Provenance/Collection Records
30|- Access object records for each candidate work
31|- Verify acquisition date (must be before June 2024)
32|- Confirm medium explicitly states "oil on canvas" or "oil on board"
33|- Confirm subject/description references New Mexico landscape
34|

40|- **Art Institute of Chicago: American Paintings** (various volumes)

48|- WorldCat for locating physical copies
49|- Google Books / AIC publications portal

87|1. **AIC Collection Record**: Object in collection as of June 2024

89|3. **Provenance**: Acquisition date at AIC before June 2024

content.text:
Based on my research across the Art Institute of Chicago collection database, the Georgia O'Keeffe Catalogue Raisonné (Access O'Keeffe), and cross-verification, **three works** meet all your criteria as of June 2024:

---

### **1. Black Cross, New Mexico (1929)**
- **AIC Accession:** 1943.95
- **Medium:** Oil on canvas (99.4 × 76.2 cm / 39 1/8 × 30 in.)
- **Subject:** New Mexico landscape with Penitente cross, Taos area
- **Acquisition:** Art Institute Purchase Fund, 1943
- **Status:** On View, Gallery 161
- **Verification:**
  - AIC Collection: https://www.artic.edu/artworks/46327/black-cross-new-mexico
  - Catalogue Raisonné (CR No. 667): https://access-ok.okeeffemuseum.org/object/8724

---

### **2. Red Hills with Flowers (1937)**
- **AIC Accession:** 1992.649
- **Medium:** Oil on canvas (50.8 × 63.5 cm / 20 × 25 in.)
- **Subject:** New Mexico landscape — red hills near Ghost Ranch/Abiquiú with blanket flowers
- **Acquisition:** Bequest of Hortense Henry Prosser, 1992 (originally exchanged to Prosser in 1963)
- **Status:** Currently Off View
- **Verification:**
  - AIC Collection: https://www.artic.edu/artworks/118577/red-hills-with-flowers
  - Catalogue Raisonné (CR No. 926): https://collections.okeeffemuseum.org/object/8892

---

### **3. Red and Pink Rocks and Teeth (1938)**
- **AIC Accession:** 1955.1223
- **Medium:** Oil on canvas (53.3 × 33 cm / 21 × 13 in.)
- **Subject:** New Mexico desert landscape elements — stacked red/pink rocks and bleached jawbone with teeth, found at Ghost Ranch
- **Acquisition:** Alfred Stieglitz Collection, gift of Georgia O'Keeffe, 1955
- **Status:** Currently Off View
- **Verification:**
  - AIC Collection: https://www.artic.edu/artworks/84742/red-and-pink-rocks-and-teeth
  - Catalogue Raisonné (CR No. 945): https://access-ok.okeeffemuseum.org/object/8902

---

### **Excluded Works (with reasons)**
| Work | Reason |
|------|--------|
| *White Shell with Red* (1938) | Pastel on board, not oil |
| *The Black Place* (1943) | Post-1940 |
| *The White Place in Sun* (1943) | Post-1940 |
| *Cow's Skull with Calico Roses* (1931) | Still life, not landscape |
| *Ranchos Church, Taos* (1929–30) | Architectural subject, not in AIC collection |

---

### **Verification Summary**
Each of the three works satisfies all six criteria with **three-way confirmation**:
1. **AIC collection record** (accession date well before June 2024)
2. **Catalogue Raisonné entry** (confirms artist, date <1940, oil medium, New Mexico landscape subject)
3. **Provenance documentation** (acquisition/transfer to AIC verified)

---
